Nina: All-hands livechat — I brought a leftover slice of pizza from yesterday and a heroic mug of chamomile. :pizza: who else is multitasking?
Omar: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheer-3o6MbrsZfQk3s9hYxy (crowd cheering) :tada:
Lila: I microwaved my sadness into something edible. also, big clap for the design team. :clap:
Rae: shoutout to Carlos for fixing the staging deploy during demo — you deserve a trophy or at least a bagel. :trophy: :bagel:
DevDeploy-bot: Deploy 1756 finished successfully by Carlos at 15:02 UTC. Logs: https://ci.example/repo/build/1756
Carlos: not a bagel person but I accept the hypothetical carb prestige. :smile:
Nina: Quick mini-poll: who wants an in-person game night next month? Reply with yes/no or :thumbsup:/:thumbsdown:.
Omar: yes! board games > slides.
Lila: depends if snacks are curated by Nina. :wink:
Rae: no, I will watch and critique from a safe distance. :binoculars:
Nina: also proposing a plant swap — bring a cutting, take a cutting. @here succulent enthusiasts? :seedling:
Carlos: @Nina accepted. I can free a small pothos.
Lila: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/plant-love-26ufdipQqU2lhNA4g (tiny plant dance)
Omar: random note: someone queued the kazoo intro music during the Q&A and I almost spat my tea. :kazoo: who did that? :joy:
Rae: guilty. was it that obvious? :see_no_evil: was a tactical decision.
(reacts: many :tada: :clap: :heart:)
Nina: closing vibes: 10/10 production, 11/10 snacks in spirit. see yall at the watercooler.
